kept.excerpt: 84% of respondents believe that gold will hold a (moderately or significantly) higher share of total reserves five years from now, up from 76% last year. In addition, 45% of respondents thought that their own institution’s gold reserves would rise over the next year, broadly in line with last year’s finding (43%). Most respondents did not expect their gold reserves to change in the next 12 months.
kept.relevance: Provides official-sector survey evidence of potential underlying demand support, while its longer horizon limits its usefulness for predicting a particular July intraday low.
